feat: Complete OASIS+ integration service implementation

- Implemented comprehensive OASIS+ browser automation with Playwright
- Added OASISClient for authentication and session management
- Created ClaimExtractor for data extraction from OASIS+ pages
- Built OASISToRCMTransformer for data transformation
- Implemented SyncService with scheduled rejection synchronization
- Added Fastify REST API for integration control
- Created comprehensive TypeScript type definitions
- Implemented HIPAA-compliant audit logging
- Added SSL certificate warning bypass (Kaspersky + browser)
- Cross-platform PowerShell compatibility with cross-env
- Bilingual support (Arabic/English) throughout
- Complete end-to-end test script (test-e2e.sh)

Status:
- Discovery script complete (968 lines)
- Integration service fully implemented
- All core services completed (FHIR Gateway, Audit, Claims Scrubbing)
- Kubernetes manifests ready for deployment
- Monorepo configuration complete

Blocker:

- Manual investigation required to verify system availability
- See OASIS_STATUS_REPORT.md for details and investigation checklist

Files:
- services/oasis-integration/ (complete integration service)

- OASIS_STATUS_REPORT.md (detailed status and next steps)
